name: Cryptographic Key Type 3 Code
definition: Codes for qualifying the type of cryptographic keys.

AES2.name: AES 128
AES2.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) 128 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 - November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

EDE3.name: DES 112
EDE3.definition: Data encryption standard key of 112 bits (without the parity bits).

DKP9.name: DUKPT 2009
DKP9.definition: DUKPT (Derived Unique Key Per Transaction) key, as specified in ANSI X9.24-2009 Annex A.

AES9.name: AES 192
AES9.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) encryption with a 192 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 – November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

AES5.name: AES 256
AES5.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) encryption with a 256 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 – November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

EDE4.name: DES 168
EDE4.definition: Data encryption standard key of 168 bits (without the parity bits).
